goal: Reuse cached compact block messages across high-bandwidth announcements and low-bandwidth peer requests
Avoid duplicate serializations and lay groundwork for compact block prefilling
agreement: Unaddressed objection: thread failure under resource exhaustion could halt block acceptance (maflcko)
Suggested using a thread pool rather than std::async to handle errors and lifecycle cleanly (andrewtoth)

Its primary value is providing leverage to unblock compact block prefilling in PR 35558
